semiconductor_relevance: Low — Niigata University primarily focuses on research and development in sensors and devices rather than direct semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: Niigata University's Abe/Sohgawa Laboratory conducts advanced research on sensors, devices, and production technologies applicable to various industrial sectors. Their work includes developing MEMS tactile sensors and microsensors with high durability, which may have indirect applications in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Multimodal MEMS tactile sensors for industrial applications
Microsensors with high durability against mechanical stress
Wiring-free measurement technology for corrosion and gas detection
